text: 这景象不可思议！你仿佛站在一扇高窗前，过去、现在与未来的滔天巨浪彼此拍击，尽收眼底。
在混乱之下，仍有清晰而真实的信息流。你摇摇欲坠地站着，试图与这些信息流调谐，让知识注入受折磨的心灵。随后，你看见……

远古时代。此地。一支高瘦、灰皮肤、面容残酷的族群。他们不是第一民族。他们更加古老，古老得可怕。他们有个名字：基瓦内玛。他们的灵魂烙印在这片土地上。他们自远古以来便统治此地。这片大陆属于他们。他们以强大的魔法和惊人的力量守护它。亚特兰蒂斯的船只燃烧，姆大陆的军队无法立足。世界有三大势力，基瓦内玛并非最弱。邪恶啊！黑暗笼罩基瓦内玛的统治之夜。他们拥有诸神，向可怖的神献祭：雷巴托斯！犹格·索托斯！扎索格！莎布·尼古拉丝！一个个噩梦般的名字。每位神都有庙宇。在他们领地的核心，有一座轮状石庙，属于伟大的风行者！伊亚，伊塔库亚！Eh-ya-ya-ya– e’yaya……ngh’aaa ngh’aaa……h’yuh……

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 450
text: The phenomenon is incredible! It is as if you stand in a high window, from which you see the crashing waves of past, present, and future all breaking upon one another.

Below all the chaos, there are streams of sense, of real information. As you stand reeling, you try to attune yourself to these streams and let the knowledge fill your tormented mind. Then, you see...

Ancient days. This place. A race of tall, lean, gray-skinned, cruel- faced men. They are not of the First Peoples. They are older, terribly old. They have a name. Keywanema. Their spirit is upon the land. They rule from antiquity. This continent is theirs. They defend it with mighty magic, awesome powers. The ships of Atlantis burn; the hosts of Mu can gain no foothold. The world has three powers, and the Keywanema are not the least. O evil! Dark is the night of the sway of the Keywanema. They have gods; they sacrifice to awful gods. Rebathoth! Yog-Sothoth! Zathog! Shub-Niggurath! Names from nightmare. To each is built a temple. In the great heart of their domain, a temple like a wheel of stone. A temple of the Great Wind-Walker! Iä Ithaqua! Eh-ya-ya-ya– e’yaya... ngh’aaa ngh’aaa... h’yuh...
